svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Print 6, plate down on the bed; supports under the core only.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Plate 170 x 170 x 12 mm; core 84 mm ball, its centre 60 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: One socket straight up: bore 24.0 mm, 65 mm deep to a flat stop;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 1.5 mm chamfer at the mouth so the button rides in.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Button hole 6 mm, 85 mm above the core centre, on the outboard

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: side, in a 16 mm finger recess with 1.5 mm of wall left.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hitch pin hole 8 mm right through, 60 mm above the core centre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: in line with the button hole.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Two anchor slots 18 mm wide at 45 degrees either side of the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: outboard side, round-ended 62 mm from the centre, open at

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the corners. The anchor uses the slot that points away from

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the shelter's middle (rear feet backward, front feet forward).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: a post end slides in to the stop with the button pressed.
